sections.text: Introduction

This document outlines 
 the maintenance procedures P1, which must be performed every equivalent 
 Operating 4000 service Hours as 
 indicated in the title block.

The over speed trip 
 protects the turbine against inadmissible speed increases when activated it 
 relieves emergency oil circuit which causes an immediate closing of the 
 turbine stop valves. The desired tripping speed can be adjusted with the over 
 speed trip in the dismantled condition..

This 
 document initiated by eng. Magdi Sami Ebrahim, tested by eng. Afifi Afifi 
 Ebrahim and eng. Mohamed Elsayed Ahmed, approved by eng.Mohamed Salah Eldin 
 Abdel-Ghafar: general director.

This 
 document revised by eng. Nageh Soliman Shousha: CEPC quality control director, 
 and certified by eng. Afaf Ebrahim El-Dib: CEPC inspection & quality control's 
 Head Sector and MPIS coordinator.

Safety 
Precautions

A 
work permit must be issued and the qualified 
maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.

Safety fence with 
caution marks surrounding the work area.

Wear safety helmet, shoes, breathing-mask, 
safety glasses is required.
The unit must be at full speed and at no load.

Introduction
This document outlines 
 the maintenance procedures P1, which must be performed every equivalent 
 Operating 4000 service Hours as 
 indicated in the title block.
The over speed trip 
 protects the turbine against inadmissible speed increases when activated it 
 relieves emergency oil circuit which causes an immediate closing of the 
 turbine stop valves. The desired tripping speed can be adjusted with the over 
 speed trip in the dismantled condition..
This 
 document initiated by eng. Magdi Sami Ebrahim, tested by eng. Afifi Afifi

 Abdel-Ghafar: general director.
This

Tools

Personal safety equipment
Personal safety equipment
Work to be carried out
Pull lever on testing device R4291 carefully.
Verify pressure GT7119 at the moment when emergency oil pressure 
GT7117 drops down to 0.03-0.1 bar.
Pull lever on testing device R4291 carefully.
Verify pressure GT7119 at the moment when emergency oil pressure 
GT7117 drops down to 0.03-0.1 bar.
Pressure GT7119 at this moment must be 0.7-0.8 bar
Alarm "emergency oil pressure" must appear.
Pull lever completely up to mechanical stop (end position).
Release lever on testing device R4291 carefully and slowly.
This 
 results that pressure GT7119 drops and pressure GT7117 increases to nominal 
 value(1.1-1.15) bar.
Alarm "emergency oil 
 pressure" must disappear.
Important:
If there are any deviations in 
characteristics during above mentioned procedure, search immediately for the 
fault.
